documents.title: Trial Period Plan Offer
documents.letterhead: US BANK · HOME MORTGAGE — Loss Mitigation
body: You are approved for a **Trial Period Plan**. Make all trial payments on time and we will make your modification permanent.
The monthly trial payment of **$2,100** covers principal, interest, and escrow at the modified terms. A 15-day grace applies; a payment past grace ends the trial.
Loss Mitigation Department — US Bank Home Mortgage
